# Appendix

The complete Mojo 1.0.0b1 [@MojoReleasesMojo] matrix multiplication implementation used throughout this
paper, including host setup, device memory allocation, and kernel dispatch, as
well as the full MLIR intermediate representations at each lowering stage
(linalg, affine, scf, and LLVM IR), are available in the accompanying
repository at \url{https://github.com/Jan-Kluger/mojo_mlir_seminar_mpcdf}.

## Benchmark Charts

The following figures show the per-kernel benchmark results summarised by the
performance portability metric $\Phi$ in @fig-overall-perf.

![Measured bandwidth for the five BabelStream operations. Each point is one benchmark run, comparing Mojo with CUDA on the H100 (top) and with HIP on the MI300A (bottom) [@godoyMojoMLIRBasedPerformancePortable2025].](images/babel_stream_perf.png){#fig-babelstream width=75%}

![miniBUDE throughput in GFLOP/s over poses per work item (PPWI) for work-group sizes 8 and 64 on the H100, comparing Mojo against CUDA with and without fast-math [@godoyMojoMLIRBasedPerformancePortable2025].](images/miniBUDE_perf.png){#fig-minibude width=75%}
